text:
anya: quick heads-up — traffic for canary-v2 is showing weird per-tenant drift, overall split was 10/90 but observed per-minute varies 3-18%.

devon: that's ... big. any correlation with header overrides or cookies?

anya: suspecting header-based overrides. we added X-Override-Profile for internal tenants last week. snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  - path: /api/generate
    split:
      - name: stable
        weight: 90
      - name: canary-v2
        weight: 10
    header_overrides:
      - header: X-Override-Profile
        match: beta
        route: canary-v2
```

mike: also saw quota-enforced short-circuits from the quota service — if tenant hits per-minute limit we fallback to stable. that could skew short windows.

sophia: telemetry: Query I ran:
```
SELECT tenant, count(*) as hits, sum(route='canary-v2') as canary_hits
FROM requests
WHERE path='/api/generate'
GROUP BY tenant
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
returned a few tenants with 40% canary due to header matches.

anya: ok — two angles: 1) header overrides are working as intended, but not shown in the console split preview; 2) quota fallback is invisible in the rollout UI. both cause perceived drift.

devon: proposal: console should show 'effective split' after applying overrides + quota fallbacks, and per-tenant breakdown. small mock in Figma incoming.

mike: agree. also can we add a metric series 'split_applied' that increments per-request with final route id? then dashboards can show real-time effective weights.

sophia: infra-bot reported failed quota-callbacks twice yesterday: infra-bot: quota-service reconnect transient, fallback path applied :warning:

anya: action items:
- devon: add 'effective split' delta panel to rollout page
- mike: make split_applied counter (tagged by tenant, header_match)
- sophia: add dashboard tiles + alert if drift > 5% vs configured
I'll open tickets.

devon: thx. one UX question — should 'effective split' be simulated (show what would happen) or measured (what's actually happening)? leaning measured.

anya: measured + simulated side-by-side. simulated for planning, measured for ops.

mike: I'll PR for the metric today. quick check: any concerns about cardinality? tagging by tenant and header value will add dims. maybe keep header value only when matched.

sophia: good call. reduce cardinality by only emitting header_match=true and header_bucket (<10) else 'other'.

devon: cool. I'll add a small note in rollout docs about overrides and quota interactions.

anya: thanks all — opening 2 tickets now: RD-4278 (split_applied metric) and RD-4279 (console effective split). ping me on the PRs.

mike: pinged. :thumbsup:
